sents.en: That's the site of the messiest, muddiest, muckiest muddle!
sents.ko: 여기가 가장 엉망이고 가장 진흙투성이인 난장판이에요!

sents.en: I fear there must be a monster in the park!
I must find where it hides.
I follow the tracks through the puddle, up the ladder, and to the top of the tunnel slide.
sents.ko: 발자국을 따라 물웅덩이를 지나, 사다리를 올라, 터널 미끄럼틀 맨 위까지 가요.

sents.en: Inside waits a monster sure to give a fright.
sents.ko: 안에는 깜짝 놀랄 만한 괴물이 기다리고 있어요.

sents.en: A monster that is furry, fanged, and covered in spikes!
sents.ko: 털이 많고, 송곳니가 났고, 온몸이 가시로 덮인 괴물이요!

sents.en: I peer in, climb on, slide down, and... YIKES!
He's monstrous mass from his hat to his boots, covered in mud and muck, his clothes soaked through.
sents.ko: 모자부터 장화까지 괴물처럼 커다랗고, 진흙과 오물로 덮였고, 옷은 흠뻑 젖었어요.

sents.en: But, under the mess of dirt and grime, I uncover — not a monster — but that silly brother of mine.
sents.ko: 그런데 흙과 때를 걷어 내니, 괴물이 아니라 우스꽝스러운 제 동생이었어요.

sents.en: Don't you think it was adventurous? Or was it scary?
I would like to spy on some monsters in the park.
sents.ko: 저는 공원에서 괴물을 몰래 살펴보고 싶어요.

sents.en: Will you come and join me?
Okay. I'll wait for you in the park. See you there.
